text:
leah: quick follow-up from last night's outage — can we agree a tiny followup loop so items don't flatline? thinking: 0-24h triage, 24-14d remediation sprint, 14-30d validation. propose single followup owner during a 2-week rotation. thoughts? :thinking_face:

mike: +1 to small windows. suggest required fields in postmortem header: one-line summary, next-step (1 line), owner, due-date, recurrence {none,suspect,confirmed}. keep it frictionless.

diego: agree. add recurrence evidence pointer (log link or span id). automation should only auto-create tickets for confirmed recurrence, suspect requires human verify.

leah: minimal SLA ideas: triage summary within 4h, remediation plan within 48h, validation scheduled within 7d. exceptions documented on the ticket.

mike: for ownership: oncall IC owns Phase 0 (triage). followup-IC for the 2-week block owns remediation coordination (not necessarily the fix). validators are reliability engineers. rotation volunteers + backup.

diego: tracking board: columns = triage / remediation / validating / closed. each card must have owner, due date, recurrence tag, and evidence pointer when suspect/confirmed. board automation: reminders at 50% and 90% of due date.

leah: propose tiny recurrence taxonomy in the template: none (isolated), suspect (pattern across >=2 deploys or hosts), confirmed (>=3 incidents or customer impact). attach quick evidence link.

mike: also propose a 15-min remediation huddle every Wed for open followups >7d to unblock cross-team deps.

diego: coding note: nightly job can mark suspect based on trace hash seen across >1 deploy in 72h. low-confidence flags should be routed to followup-IC for verification.

ops-bot: created followup ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-7007 and scheduled reminder in 72h. :white_check_mark:

leah: action items: mike -> add header fields to postmortem template (due 24h), diego -> prototype nightly detection with confidence score (due 4d), I'll publish rotation signup and calendar invites (due EOW). I'll also draft a 1-page playbook.

mike: will update template and make evidence pointer required when recurrence!=none.

diego: starting prototype, will post staging link in thread when ready.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: followup owners check-in in 72h (thread 1778889999).

leah: thanks all — if no objections I'll attach the playbook and enable the staging job after tests. closing thread for now, will reopen on RI-7007. :sparkles:
